source_contract.prompt_template: Create a single continuous {material_name} material swatch for a 2D JRPG tileset source. Orthographic top-down texture sample, frame completely filled by one material at uniform scale, edge-to-edge substrate, no focal point. Regional palette/material hint only: {region_material_hint}. Subtle handcrafted Plushbound fiber or grain character must exist inside the material itself, never as separate objects. NO environment, landscape, map, terrain scene, diorama, game level, horizon, perspective, bridge, building, ruin, tree, bush, grass clump, water body, pond, river, path, road, character, creature, furniture, tool, prop, debris, isolated object, border, tile grid, checkerboard, contact sheet, text, letters, numbers, glyphs, symbols, logo or sign.
required_prompt_phrases: frame completely filled by one material
